name: Client confidentiality / IP leak
description: Sensitive client material disclosed via lost device, mis-sent email, ex-employee.

name: Scope dispute / non-payment
description: Client disputes scope or quality and refuses to pay; firm absorbs loss.

name: Key-person dependency
description: Lead consultant departs / unavailable; client relationship + delivery at risk.

name: Time-sheet / expense fraud
description: Staff inflate billable hours / submit fictitious expenses.

name: PII inadvertently included in deliverable
description: Client PII or competitor-sensitive data included in a document shared more widely than intended.
